test_cases.description: Login with demo credentials, login with invalid credentials, sign-up link, logout, and session persistence after page refresh and direct URL access
steps: Navigate to login page
Attempt login with invalid credentials - verify error message
Click 'Fill demo credentials' and login - verify dashboard loads
Refresh page - verify session persists
Navigate directly to /vault/passwords - verify access
Logout - verify redirect to login
Navigate to /vault/passwords while logged out - verify redirect to login
Verify sign-up link navigates to /signup

test_cases.description: Verify summary counts match actual items in each section, verify recent items cards are clickable and navigate correctly
steps: Login and navigate to dashboard
Verify counts: Adgangskoder=3, Enheder=5, Abonnementer=4, Sikre noter=3, Familie=5
Click each summary card - verify navigation to correct section
Click a recent element card - verify navigation

test_cases.description: Create new password entry with all fields, edit existing entry, delete entry, verify password masking, test filter/search functionality
steps: Click 'Tilføj ny' to open create modal
Fill all fields (Titel, Brugernavn/E-mail, Adgangskode, Websted-URL, Noter)
Toggle sharing and save - verify entry appears
Click entry to edit - verify all fields persisted correctly
Update title and save - verify update
Delete entry via context menu - confirm deletion
Test filter by typing in filter box - verify results

test_cases.description: Create new device, edit existing device, delete device, verify device type categorization, test filter functionality
steps: Click 'Tilføj ny' to open create modal

Delete entry and verify removal

Click save with empty title - verify validation prevents submission
Enter XSS payload as title - verify it is escaped on render

Press Enter - verify search results page

steps: Click each sidebar link - verify correct page loads
Navigate to /nonexistent-page - verify 404 handling
Use browser back/forward buttons - verify navigation

test_cases.description: Verify 'Del med familien' toggle changes item visibility badge, verify toggle state persists after save
steps: Open an existing 'Privat' item
Toggle 'Del med familien' ON and save
Verify badge changes from 'Privat' to 'Delt'
Re-open item - verify toggle state persisted
Toggle back OFF and save - verify badge reverts
